text: Harald Pihl GmbH is the Krefeld-registered German company of the HARALD PIHL group (Krefeld HRB 18499, managing director Tobias Böke); the group's headquarters is HARALD PIHL in Täby, Sweden.
short: Harald Pihl GmbH is the German company of the Täby-headquartered HARALD PIHL group.
